Container.Name: org3d
Container.Overview: Local gallery and organiser for 3D print files (3MF/STL): search, 3D preview, projects. Built to leave array disks asleep: rescans only read new or changed files, 3D previews are cached on appdata, and nothing polls the library in the background. Set a login below, and keep it on your LAN or behind a reverse proxy with TLS. Runs locked down: read-only root filesystem, no capabilities, 2 GB memory cap.

Config.Name: Library
Config.Description: Folder with your 3MF/STL files. Read-only by default. Change to rw to use Extract ZIPs (writes extracted folders next to each ZIP) or Duplicates (moves copies into .org3d-trash at the top of the library).

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Database, thumbnails and preview cache. Keep it on the cache pool, never the array: put appdata on a cache-only or exclusive share, or use /mnt/cache/appdata/org3d. SQLite WAL mode has problems over the /mnt/user FUSE layer if the share is not exclusive.

Config.Name: Login (user:password)
Config.Description: Require a login for the web UI, as user:password (password at least 8 characters). Strongly recommended: without it anyone on your network can rescan, extract into the library and change projects. Sent over plain HTTP, so use a password you don't use anywhere else.

Config.Name: Daily rescan time
Config.Description: HH:MM (24h, container TZ) to rescan once a day, e.g. 04:00. Leave empty to rescan manually only. Unchanged files are skipped using directory metadata. With the Cache Dirs plugin keeping the library's directories in RAM, a rescan only wakes disks whose files actually changed.

Config.Name: Preview cache (MiB)
Config.Description: Disk space on appdata for cached 3D previews, so viewing a model again doesn't wake its disk. 0 turns the cache off.

Config.Name: Purge missing after (days)
Config.Description: Files that disappear are hidden but kept, with their project, for this many days in case a disk was only offline. After that they are deleted from the index. 0 keeps them forever.
